title: August and the Ledger
author: Silas Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Sandoval, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
